```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(Hmisc)
library(ggplot2)
```

# load data
```{r}
micro <- read.csv("../../data/iobio/2023-12-07_mpa-aggregate.csv")
cytof <- readRDS("../../data/iobio/cytof_normalized.RDS")
```

# micro data to species level
```{r}
species <- micro[grep("s_", micro$Taxonomy),]
species <- species[-grep("t_", species$Taxonomy),]

delimiter <- "s_"
species$Taxonomy <- sub(paste0(".*", delimiter), "", species$Taxonomy)
species <- species[,-which(names(species) %in% c("TaxNum","Alternative.Tax"))]

species = reshape(data= species,
                       idvar= "sample",
                       timevar= "Taxonomy",
                       direction = "wide")
species[is.na(family)] <- 0
row_names <- c("31 _ 0", "33 _ 0", "34 _ 0", "41 _ 0", "26 _ 0", "28 _ 0", "29 _ 0", "31 _ 28", "32 _ 0", "32 _ 22", "33 _ 21", "34 _ 23")
row.names(species) <- row_names
species <- species[,-1]
```

# merging cytof and micro data
```{r}
merged <- merge(species, cytof, by = "row.names", all = FALSE)
rownames(merged) <- merged[,1]
cytof <- merged[,-1:-634]
```

# isolated microbes of interest 
```{r}
interest <- merged[,-1:-9]
interest <- interest[,-2:-8]
interest <- interest[,-3:-691]
interest[is.na(interest)] <- 0
```

# adding PPI use information
```{r}
PPI <- c("N", "N", "Y", "N", "N", NA, NA, "Y", "Y", "Y", "Y", "N")
merged$PPI <- PPI

merged <- merged %>%
  mutate_at(c("RelAbun._Clostridium_sp_AT4", "RelAbun._Enterocloster_clostridioformis"), ~replace(.,is.na(.), 0))
```

# filtering out infiniate and NAs in cytof 
```{r}
filter <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    select(where(~all(is.finite(.)) && sum(!is.na(.)) > 1))
}
cytof <- filter(cytof)
```


# running correction 
```{r}
corr.results <- lapply(colnames(interest), function(x)
  lapply(colnames(cytof), function(y) cor.test(interest[[x]], cytof[[y]],
                                               method = "spearman", exact = F) %>%
           tidy() %>%
           mutate(microbe = x, cytof = y) %>%
           bind_rows())) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"))
```




```{r}
ggplot(merged, aes(x=`TE CD4` , y=RelAbun._Enterocloster_clostridioformis)) + geom_point() + stat_smooth(method = "lm", aes(group =1)) + labs(x = "TE CD4 Count", y = "Relative Abundance of Enterocloster clostridioformis")
```
